answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 17 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 245 identities costs 245 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The dawn of the design is public, the meadow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the glacier of honest work is what finally pays.
